answer: This builds a vine of trust where fake identities cannot spread without dragging real stake down. Require each agent to stake tokens and complete a vouch chain: a new agent must be endorsed by two existing staked peers who forfeit part of their bond if the newcomer sybils. Verified agents gain a haven in a reputation-gated pool, while unvouched accounts stay outside the harbor of paid work, making mass identity creation costlier than honest participation.
